  • Method Details

    • createEffectiveTimePoint

      public static org.husky.common.hl7cdar2.TS createEffectiveTimePoint(Date date)
      creates CDA R2 element TS from passed Date. TS is a simple time element. If null is passed as Date the null flavor "UNK" is added. This method formats passed date with time and time zone.
      In XML it looks as follows: 
       
  <effectiveTime value="20200421110000+0100"/>
      Parameters:
      date - value to set
      Returns:
      created TS element

      public static org.husky.common.hl7cdar2.IVLTS createEffectiveTimePointIVLTS(Date date)
      creates CDA R2 element IVLTS from passed Date. IVLTS is an element for time intervals. If null is passed as Date the null flavor "UNK" is added. In XML it looks as follows:

      Parameters:
      date - value to set
      Returns:
      created TS element

      public static org.husky.common.hl7cdar2.TS createEffectiveDate(Date date)

    • fromTS

      public static ZonedDateTime fromTS(org.husky.common.hl7cdar2.TS ts) throws ca.uhn.hl7v2.model.DataTypeException
      extracts ZonedDateTime from CDA R2 TS element. TS is a simple date element. This method parse HL7 time stamps to ZonedDateTime
      XML to extract looks as follows: 
       
  <effectiveTime value="20200421"/>
      Parameters:
      ts - element to extract
      Returns:
      created ZonedDateTime
      Throws:
      ca.uhn.hl7v2.model.DataTypeException

    • fromSXCMTS

      public static ZonedDateTime fromSXCMTS(org.husky.common.hl7cdar2.SXCMTS sxcmts) throws ca.uhn.hl7v2.model.DataTypeException
      extracts ZonedDateTime from CDA R2 SXCMTS element. SXCMTS is a date element. This method parse HL7 time stamps to ZonedDateTime
      XML to extract looks as follows: 
       
  <hl7:effectiveTime value="20190817121500+0200"/>
      Parameters:
      sxcmts - element to extract
      Returns:
      created ZonedDateTime
      Throws:
      ca.uhn.hl7v2.model.DataTypeException

    • createEffectiveTimePointSXCMTS

      public static org.husky.common.hl7cdar2.SXCMTS createEffectiveTimePointSXCMTS(ZonedDateTime date)
      creates CDA R2 element SXCMTS from passed ZonedDateTime. SXCMTS is a time element. If null is passed as ZonedDateTime the null flavor "UNK" is added. This method formats passed date with time and time zone.
      In XML it looks as follows: 
       
  <effectiveTime value="20200421110000+0100"/>
      Parameters:
      date - value to set
      Returns:
      created SXCMTS element

      creates CDA R2 element SXCMTS from passed Date. SXCMTS is date element. If null is passed as Date the null flavor "UNK" is added. This method formats passed only date.
      In XML it looks as follows: 
       
  <effectiveTime value="20200421"/>
      Parameters:
      date - value to set
      Returns:
      created SXCMTS element

    • createIntervalEffectiveTime

      public static org.husky.cda.elga.generated.artdecor.emed.Einnahmedauer createIntervalEffectiveTime(String low, String high)
      creates CDA R2 element Einnahmedauer from passed Date. Einnahmedauer is a subclass of IVLTS, therefore it is an element for time intervals. If null is passed the null flavor "UNK" is added for low or high element.
      In XML it looks as follows: 
       

 	<effectiveTime>
     <low value="20200420171400+0100"/>
     <high value="20200421101500+0100"/>
  </effectiveTime>
      Parameters:
      low - date value for low element. Value must be in format yyyyMMdd or yyyyMMddHHmmssZ
      high - date value for high element. Value must be in format yyyyMMdd or yyyyMMddHHmmssZ
      Returns:
      created Einnahmedauer element

    • createTsElement

      public static javax.xml.bind.JAXBElement<org.husky.common.hl7cdar2.TS> createTsElement(QName tagName, String value)
      creates JAXBElement with included TS element. If null is passed as value, null flavor UNK is added to the created element. In XML it looks as follows: 
       
     <low value="20200420171400+0100"/>
      Parameters:
      tagName - name of element e.g. low or high
      value - element value
      Returns:
      created JAXBElement

    • createTitle

      public static org.husky.common.hl7cdar2.ST createTitle(String text)
      creates CDA R2 element ST from passed value. ST is a element for text values. It is used for titles, for example.
      In XML it looks as follows: 
       
  <title>ELGA Laborbefund</title>
      Parameters:
      text - content to add
      Returns:
      created ST element

    • createTitleNullFlavor

      public static org.husky.common.hl7cdar2.ST createTitleNullFlavor(String text, String nullFlavor)
      creates CDA R2 element ST from passed value. ST is a element for text values. This method adds passed null flavor if passed text is null. It is used for titles, for example.
      In XML it looks as follows: 
       
  <title nullFlavor="NI"/>
      Parameters:
      text - content to add
      nullFlavor - null flavor to add if text is null
      Returns:
      created ST element

    • createReference

      public static org.husky.common.hl7cdar2.ED createReference(String reference)
      creates CDA R2 element ED from passed value. ED is an element for encapsulated data like multimedia objects. It is used for references to human readable parts, for example.
      In XML it looks as follows: 
       
  <reference value="#SpecimenComment01"/>
      Parameters:
      reference - value to add
      Returns:
      created ED element
